manual.title: Connection details
manual.description: Enter endpoints and proxy credentials from your own app traffic. They may differ from the app login.

channels.title: Choose channel types
channels.description: Move a number from lights to fans to change type. The previous HA entity is removed. Apple Home rooms/scenes/automations may need reassignment. Reload HomeKit Bridge after saving.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure connection
reconfigure.description: Entity identities are preserved. Re-enter the password.

error.invalid_connection: Check HTTP URLs and proxy credentials.
error.invalid_channels: Select distinct channel numbers or ranges, with no overlap between lights and fans.
error.invalid_auth: Proxy authentication failed. Return to connection settings or capture fresh credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read the channel. Check connection, channel and compatibility.
error.missing_connection: commax_connection.json is missing from the HA configuration directory.
